mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:late-cycle expansion defined by GDP growth > 2% and UNRATE < 5%
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand that increases corporate sales and earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trend fails to correlate with positive 5-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust aggregate demand that elevates corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 and HOUST rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates central bank policy acceleration that increases real interest rates and equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:monetary tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 2% YoY
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, rising CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.
